reauth_postnl.title: PostNL login expired
reauth_postnl.description:
1. Open this link and log in to PostNL: {authorize_url}
2. After login the browser tries to open a `postnl://login?code=...` address (it may show an error). Copy that complete address from the address bar or the developer tools (Network tab) and paste it below.

reauth_amazon_password.title: Amazon.nl login needed
reauth_amazon_password.description: Amazon asked for a new login (wrong password, captcha or verification code). Log in once on amazon.nl in a browser, then enter your credentials again. Empty fields keep the stored value.

reauth_amazon_browser.title: Amazon.nl login needed
reauth_amazon_browser.description:
The Amazon login expired or was revoked.
1. Open this link and log in: {signin_url}
2. Copy the complete address of the error page shown after the login (`{maplanding}...`) and paste it below.

Stores: {stores}. The sign-in page is on amazon.de for all European stores (amazon.nl has no sign-in page of its own); it is the same Amazon account.

data.amazon_redirect_url: Address of the Amazon page after login

reauth_amazon_cookies.title: Amazon.nl cookies expired
reauth_amazon_cookies.description: amazon.nl no longer accepts the stored cookies. Log in on amazon.nl in your browser, open your orders, copy the `Cookie` request header from the developer tools (F12 -> Network) and paste it below.

reauth_amazon_proxy.title: Amazon login needed
reauth_amazon_proxy.description:
A new window opens with the Amazon sign-in page, served through Home Assistant. Log in with your Amazon account (stores: {stores}); captchas and verification codes appear there as usual. When the login is complete the window closes and this dialog continues by itself. Nothing to copy.

If the window does not open, allow pop-ups for Home Assistant.

postnl.title: PostNL account
postnl.description:
Status: {status}.
The account sync uses the unofficial PostNL app login and may stop working if PostNL changes it.
1. Open this link and log in to PostNL: {authorize_url}
2. After login the browser tries to open a `postnl://login?code=...` address (it may show an error). Copy that complete address from the address bar or the developer tools (Network tab) and paste it below. Leave empty to keep the current login.

amazon.title: Amazon orders (experimental)
amazon.description:
Adds new DHL, PostNL and Dragonfly shipments from your Amazon orders automatically. Orders exist only in the store they were placed in, so select every store you order from (amazon.nl, amazon.de, amazon.fr, amazon.es, ...); each one is read separately.

Warning: the Amazon Conditions of Use forbid automated access. Amazon may ask for captchas or restrict your account. Use at your own risk. Orders are read every 30-60 minutes, only inside the refresh window.

Browser login (recommended): you log in on Amazon yourself (captchas and verification codes are handled in your browser); Home Assistant only keeps a login token, no password. Password login: uses your email and password; it stops when Amazon asks for a captcha.

Cookie login: you copy the cookies of your own logged-in amazon.nl browser session; most reliable when the browser login does not work.

data.amazon_stores: Amazon stores to read orders from

amazon_browser.title: Amazon login - paste the address
amazon_browser.description:
Status: {status}.
1. Open this link and log in with your Amazon account (the same account as amazon.nl): {signin_url}
2. After the login Amazon shows an error page ("page not found"). That is expected.
3. Copy the complete address of that page from the address bar (it starts with `{maplanding}` and contains `openid.oa2.authorization_code`) and paste it below within a few minutes.

A device "Parcel Tracking NL" is added to your Amazon account (Your devices). Remove it there to revoke the login. Leave empty to keep the current login.

Stores: {stores}. The sign-in page is on amazon.de for all European stores (amazon.nl has no sign-in page of its own); it is the same Amazon account.

data.amazon_redirect_url: Address of the Amazon page after login

amazon_password.title: Amazon password login
amazon_password.description: Empty fields keep the stored value. The integration never solves captchas: it stops and asks you to log in again.

amazon_cookies.title: Amazon cookies from your browser
amazon_cookies.description:
Status: {status}. Stores: {stores}.
1. Log in on each store in your browser (tick "Keep me signed in") and open {orders_url}.
2. Open the developer tools (F12) -> Network, reload the page, click the first request (orders) and copy the value of the request header `Cookie`.
3. Paste it below, one line per store. The store is recognized by its sign-in cookie (`x-acbnl`, `x-acbde`, `x-acbfr`, `x-acbes`, ...).

The cookies are stored obfuscated and used only to read your orders. When Amazon ends a session, Home Assistant asks you to paste new cookies. Leave empty to keep the current cookies.

postnl_postal_code_missing.title: PostNL needs your postal code
postnl_postal_code_missing.description: PostNL tracking needs the receiver's postal code. Add it in the integration options (General) or use the track_parcel action with `postal_code`. Affected PostNL parcels are skipped until then.

amazon_auth_required.title: Amazon.nl login needed
amazon_auth_required.description: Amazon asked for a new login, a captcha or a verification code. Amazon order polling is stopped; DHL, PostNL and Dragonfly tracking continue. Reconfigure the integration to log in again.

amazon_unavailable.title: Amazon.nl orders unavailable
amazon_unavailable.description: The amazon-orders library could not be installed or loaded, so Amazon.nl orders are not checked. Carrier tracking continues.
